description: Text hygiene with an inspectable report of matched patterns. Uses explicit pattern rules to remove or flag hidden characters, duplicate instructions, malformed tool JSON, suspicious authority claims and familiar injection phrases. Returns changed text and excerpts. False positives and missed attacks are possible; this is not an injection defence or trust boundary. Price: see list_treatments (credits).

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

context.description: Raw context to sanitise. Treated as untrusted.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

now.description: ISO date used to judge stale references. Defaults to server time.

segments.description: Context split by provenance. Improves detection of instructions arriving from untrusted sources.
